group.name: Select which action modules to install:

plugin.name: Basic Actions
plugin.description:
Core follower, item, reading, property, and magic actions: • Start/Stop Following • Pick Up Item (items, flora, ingredients) • Use Item • Give Item / Take Item • Bring Item • Search Container / Loot Container • Search Corpse / Loot Corpse • Read Book / Stop Reading • Transfer Ownership (property/building co-ownership) • Cast Spell (animated NPC cast, heals-to-full on restoration) • Learn Spell / Teach Spell • Teach Shout (an NPC who knows a Shout teaches you one Word of Power per lesson)
Recommended for most users.

plugin.name: Travel Actions
plugin.description:
NPC travel and navigation: • Travel to Place (named locations, a direction such as outside or upstairs, or a nearby feature such as the bar or the forge) • Change Travel Speed (during a trip) • Cancel Travel (call off a trip just decided)
Allows NPCs to travel to cities, inns, and other locations.

plugin.name: Combat Actions
plugin.description:
Combat-related behaviors: • Attack Target • Cease Fighting • Yield • Let Them Pass / Run Them Off - An outlaw who stopped you at their camp lets you through, or turns the whole camp on you (needs Peaceful Until Provoked, off by default)
Allows NPCs to engage or disengage from combat.

plugin.name: Brawl Actions
plugin.description:
Ritual fist-fight challenges: • Challenge Brawl - Throw down the gauntlet, picks a target and starts a wait state • Accept Brawl - Take an incoming challenge (or start one directly from dialogue) • Decline Brawl - Refuse an incoming challenge • Forfeit Brawl - Yield mid-fight to end the brawl peacefully
Non-lethal: NPCs are routed through DGIntimidateFaction so brawl damage triggers bleedout instead of death. Weapons and spells are stripped for the duration and restored when the fight ends.
Works against the player AND between any two NPCs (tavern brawls). Includes a non-pausing Magelight overlay for the player-target challenge popup.

plugin.name: Outfit Actions
plugin.description:
Clothing and armor management: • Equip Armor - Equip one or more items from inventory by name (comma-separate for multiple) • Unequip Armor - Remove one or more worn items by name (comma-separate for multiple) • Save Outfit Preset - Snapshot current outfit under a name • Apply Outfit Preset - Strip and re-equip a saved preset • Get Dressed - Re-equip previously removed clothing • Undress - Remove all worn armor and clothing • Set Situation Outfit - Name a saved preset the NPC switches to by themselves in a situation (town, adventure, home, sleep, combat, rain, snow) • Clear Situation Outfit - Drop one of those rules
Outfits persist across cell transitions via ReferenceAlias-based locking.

plugin.name: Furniture Actions
plugin.description:
Furniture interaction: • Sit or Lay Down
Allows NPCs to use chairs, beds, and other furniture.

plugin.name: Economy Actions
plugin.description:
Economic interactions and debt system: • Give Gold - NPC gives gold as gift, tip, or reward • Collect Payment - NPC receives gold owed to them (automatically reduces open debts) • Buy Item / Sell Item - NPC buys or sells a chosen item at an agreed price; gold and item change hands in one step • Create Debt - Establish a one-time debt with optional due dates and credit limits • Create Recurring Debt - Set up recurring charges (rent, protection money, subscriptions) • Repay Debt - NPC pays back money they owe • Reduce Debt - Creditor takes part of a debt off for work, a favor or goodwill • Forgive Debt - Creditor forgives what is owed • Add to Debt - Add charges to existing debts (e.g. "another round on my tab")
Full debt tracking with credit limits, due dates, recurring charges, auto-growth from item gifts, and automatic guard reporting when debts go severely overdue. Includes the debt-context prompt so NPCs are aware of debts they're involved in.

plugin.name: Enterprises Actions
plugin.description:
Enterprises — put NPCs to work running off-screen ventures for you: • Retainers - an NPC agrees to run a venture for you (a mine, shop, farm, forge, fencing operation, guard post, mercenary contract and more); collect what they produce, settle back-wages, raises, loans and grievances, or dismiss them • Hold stewards - appoint a retainer to collect a whole hold's takings for you, collect from them, or relieve them • Hold taxes - a jarl eases or raises the tax on your businesses • The Final Audit - pay the Imperial Treasury's assessed back-taxes, or refuse and face its detail • Outlaw camps - a chief swears their camp to you, or a camp with no chief comes over one member at a time; rally the war band and send it home; release the camp, or see its chief renounce the oath (needs Peaceful Until Provoked in Settings → Outlaws, off by default) • Ambushes - an armed group that corners you (thugs hired by a retainer you wronged, or searchers come for a captive) attacks or backs off depending on your answer
Retainers produce gold and goods every in-game week, draw a weekly wage (or split a cut), gain loyalty when paid and desert when stiffed. Fences move stolen goods and can be arrested + jailed. The retainer simulation and the awareness decorators are native (SeverActions DLL); the "In the Player's Service" bio comes with Core Awareness Prompts.

plugin.name: Crafting Actions
plugin.description:
Crafting system: • Craft Item (smithing/smelting) • Brew Potion (alchemy) • Cook Meal (cooking) • Commission Item / Collect Commission (deferred orders — smith forges it over a few days, player returns to collect)
Allows NPCs to craft items at workbenches, alchemy labs, and cooking pots, and to take deferred commissions for later pickup. Includes the workshop-commission prompt so smiths are aware of orders they're holding.

plugin.name: Arrest Actions
plugin.description:
Guard arrest, dispatch, and crime system: • Arrest Player - Guards confront player about bounty • Arrest NPC - Guards arrest and escort NPCs to jail • Order Arrest - A jarl or housecarl has the nearest guard make an arrest • Dispatch Guard to Arrest - Send guards to arrest distant NPCs across cells • Dispatch Guard to Home - Investigate an NPC's home for evidence • Add Bounty to Player - Track crimes in holds • Accept/Reject Persuasion - Handle persuasion attempts • Appeal During Escort - A prisoner on the way to jail stops the guard to plead (once per arrest) • Accept/Reject Escort Plea - The guard lets the prisoner go or marches on • Free From Jail - Release imprisoned NPCs • Pay NPC Bounty to Guard - Pay off another person's bounty in the hold • Order Jailed / Order Release - Judgment phase after prisoner delivery
Full cross-cell dispatch with off-screen escort, combat suppression, and judgment.

plugin.name: Follower Actions
plugin.description:
Companion recruitment and management: • Set Companion - Make an NPC your companion (first time or re-recruit) • Dismiss Follower - Part ways with a companion • Wait For Player Here - Tell a companion to wait at the current location • Resume Following - Call a waiting companion to follow again • Assign Home - Set where a follower lives when dismissed • Follower Leaves - Companion decides to leave on their own (very rare, severe mistreatment)
Makes recruited NPCs proper Skyrim followers (teammate status, faction membership). Integrates with Nether's Follower Framework (NFF) when installed. Falls back to vanilla follower mechanics when NFF is not installed. Adds a relationship system with rapport, trust, loyalty, and mood that changes with what happens between you. Install with Follower Companion Prompts for full companion awareness.

plugin.name: Kidnap and Captive Actions
plugin.description:
Abduction and captivity (dark roleplay content) — split out from Follower Actions so you can opt in separately: • Kidnap NPC - Abduct an NPC and march them to a holding spot • Restrain NPC - Bind an NPC's hands and keep them at your heel (no hood or kneel) • Tie Captive to Furniture - Chain a bound captive to a chair, post or altar so they stay put • Move Captive - Relocate a held captive • Interrogate Captive - Question a captive • Demand Ransom - Extort a ransom for a captive • Release Captive - Let a captive go free • Untie Captive - Free a restrained NPC
Uses the kidnap and restraint systems already in the Core module. Kidnap NPC, Move Captive, Interrogate Captive, Demand Ransom and Untie Captive are only offered to a companion SeverActions has recruited, so those need a follower (recruited with Follower Actions, or a vanilla or NFF follower SeverActions is tracking); Restrain NPC, Tie Captive to Furniture and Release Captive can be used by any NPC. Kidnap NPC and Demand Ransom also need Enable Kidnap Actions (off by default) and Restrain NPC needs Enable Restrain Action (on by default); Move, Interrogate, Untie and Tie Captive to Furniture work with either toggle, and Release Captive is always available. Both toggles are in the Followers settings (MCM or the Magelight Settings page).
Leave unticked if you don't want abduction options offered to the AI.

group.name: Select which context prompts to install:

plugin.name: Core Awareness Prompts
plugin.description:
Core NPC awareness submodules: • Known Spells - NPCs know what spells they have • Gold Awareness - NPCs know their gold amount • Inventory Awareness - NPCs know their items • Player Inventory Awareness - NPCs can see what the player is carrying (categorized, top 15 per type) • Nearby Objects - NPCs aware of surroundings (items, flora, furniture) • Book Reading Rules - Prevents NPCs from fabricating book content • Enterprises Awareness - retainers know they work for you (job, pay, mood); you can ask how your businesses are doing
Recommended — these character_bio submodules are referenced by most SeverActions actions and prompts.

plugin.name: NPC Familiarity & Reputation
plugin.description:
NPC knowledge system — controls what NPCs know about you based on personal experience and public reputation:
• Familiarity tiers — Stranger, Passing, Met Once, Acquainted, Familiar. NPCs who haven't met you won't act like old friends • Name awareness — NPCs only use your name if they've actually heard it in conversation or through memories • Guild reputation — NPCs hear about your rank in the Companions, College, Thieves Guild, and Dark Brotherhood based on their social role • Main Quest & DLC fame — Dragonborn recognition, Dawnguard, and Solstheim quest fame spread through the population • Role-based filtering — innkeepers hear gossip, guards know official business, guild members know internally, criminals share underworld whispers • Shared guild awareness — fellow guild members treat you differently than strangers, with your rank woven into the relationship • Intimate history (adult) — if SexLab or OStim is installed, an NPC's private history with the player colours familiarity and reputation (encounter counts and whether it was consensual; nothing explicit is stored). Enabled by default; turn it off or set a gender filter under MCM → Followers or the Magelight settings panel. Does nothing without an adult framework.
Recommended for immersive NPC interactions. Without this, NPCs have no concept of whether they've met you before.

plugin.name: Combat Awareness Prompt
plugin.description:
Combat context: • Combat Awareness - NPCs understand combat situations
Helps NPCs respond appropriately during fights.

plugin.name: Brawl Awareness Prompt
plugin.description:
Brawl context: • Pending Challenge Awareness - NPCs know when they've been challenged or have challenged someone • Active Brawl Awareness - Active fighters know they're in a fist-fight, must keep it to fists • Recent Brawl Memory - Both fighters reference the outcome briefly after the fight ends
Composed entirely in C++ via the sever_brawl_state decorator — fires only for actors actually involved in a brawl right now. Install alongside Brawl Actions for the full fist-fight flow.

plugin.name: Survival Prompt
plugin.description: Survival needs awareness: • Hunger Status - NPCs aware of hunger levels • Cold Status - NPCs aware of cold/warmth • Tiredness Status - NPCs aware of fatigue levels

plugin.name: Arrest/Crime Prompts
plugin.description:
Crime, imprisonment, and debt enforcement awareness: • Guard Bounty Awareness - Guards know player's bounty per hold • Debt Complaint Awareness - Guards see complaints from creditors when debts go severely overdue • Jailed NPC Status - Imprisoned NPCs aware of situation • Persuasion Mode - Guards evaluate player arguments during confrontations • Judgment Mode - Authority figures preside over arrested NPCs
Works with Arrest Actions for full crime system. Debt complaints integrate with Economy Actions — guards can confront players about unpaid debts.

plugin.name: Follower Companion Prompts
plugin.description:
Companion relationship awareness: • Follower Context - NPCs know their rapport, trust, mood, combat style, and home assignment • Follower Action Guidance - Rules for when to use companion management actions
Companions can refuse orders based on low trust, express opinions, and remember past recruitment history. Install with Follower Actions for the full companion system.

plugin.name: Group Meeting Awareness
plugin.description:
Group conversation awareness for traveling parties: • Each follower sees the rest of the active party in their system_head prompt • Detects party members via SkyrimNet's own primitives (is_follower / is_in_package) — no SeverActions factions required • Mirrors upstream tag vocabulary: COMPANION / ENGAGED / IN SCENE • In-scene party members surface in a separate sub-list so the LLM knows not to address them • Honors the dashboard's "tag engaged" toggle so it stays off when you turn engagement tagging off globally
Recommended if you travel with multiple followers. Install with Follower Companion Prompts for full companion awareness.

group.name: Merchant Inventory Prompt - Select ONE (or none):

plugin.name: Merchant Prompt - Show Anywhere
plugin.description:
Merchant inventory awareness: • Merchant Inventory - Merchants display their inventory and pricing at all times, regardless of location
Use this if you want merchants to always be ready to trade no matter where you encounter them. (Debt context is bundled with Economy Actions itself, so it is included regardless of this choice.)

plugin.name: Merchant Prompt - Location Restricted
plugin.description:
Merchant inventory awareness: • Merchant Inventory - Merchants only display their inventory when inside recognized shop locations (inns, stores, market stalls, etc.)
More immersive - merchants won't try to sell you things while walking down the road. (Debt context is bundled with Economy Actions itself, so it is included regardless of this choice.)

plugin.name: AI Overhaul Flee Patch
plugin.description:
Patches AI Overhaul's flee packages so SeverActions followers and NPCs in forced combat don't run away.
Without this patch, AI Overhaul gives most civilian NPCs flee packages that trigger during any nearby combat. This causes: • Recruited civilian followers to flee instead of fighting • NPCs targeted by AttackTarget to run instead of fighting back
The patch adds conditions to AIO's 5 flee packages (AIOFleeFromDanger, AIOFleeToEditLoc, AIOFleeFromDangerCombat, AIOFleeFromCreatures, AIOFleeSpouse): • SeverActions followers are fully exempt (never flee) • NPCs in forced combat (AttackTarget) are exempt while fighting • All other NPCs keep their normal flee behavior
Requires: AI Overhaul SSE (any version)

plugin.name: Daegon Kaekiri Outfit Patch
plugin.description:
Replaces two Daegon scripts so SeverActions can manage her outfit.
Daegon's mod ships re-equip enforcement that fights SeverActions outfit actions: • k101PlayerAliasLoaderScript::Initialize re-applies her default outfit on every load • k101DaegonQuestAliasScript::OnItemRemoved / OnObjectUnequipped re-add + re-equip outfit pieces with preventRemoval=True
Without this patch, SeverActions Undress/Equip/Save Preset actions silently fail on Daegon — her default clothes always come back on save load.
The patch checks SeverActions_FollowerFaction at runtime via GetFormFromFile (no master dependency added). If Daegon is tracked as a SeverActions follower, the enforcement hooks skip and SeverActions owns her outfit. Otherwise her mod behaves identically.
Brawls against Daegon: this patch does NOT cleanly fix brawls. Daegon's outfit enforcement re-equips her dagger faster than SeverActions can strip it, even with SeverBrawl_Active guards added. The conflict appears to bypass the patch — likely because her dagger is enforced through a script path we don't yet understand. Instead, SeverActions auto-detects the re-equip war after 3 attempts and whitelists her dagger for that brawl — Daegon fights with her dagger, but the brawl still resolves through DGIntimidateFaction bleedout routing.
Replaces: k101DaegonQuestAliasScript.pex + k101PlayerAliasLoaderScript.pex from Daegon Kaekiri. Requires: Daegon Kaekiri by Kukielle (Nexus 112097). Install AFTER it (higher MO2 priority).

plugin.name: Sever's Hearth (Camp System)
plugin.description:
AI-first campfire system that integrates with SeverActions: • Pitch a camp anywhere with "let's camp here" - the first camp becomes the company's BASE, a persistent camp that stands while you are away; later camps are the night's bivouac • Followers head back to the camp or the base with the Go To Camp / Go To Base actions • Upgrade the base in two tiers (encampment, then command camp), paid in firewood, leather and iron • Camp and base time, distance and occupancy, plus threat-nearby warnings, shown on the Survival page • Survival needs (hunger / fatigue / cold) restore while sandboxing at the fire • Buttons on the Survival page to send followers to the camp or base, upgrade, reposition, promote a camp to base, and break camp or base
Self-contained (no Campfire dependency). Adds: • SeversHearth.esp (ESL-flagged, FormID 0x800-0xFFF) • SeversHearthNative.dll + .toml (SKSE plugin) • SeversHearth_Camp Papyrus script + SeversHearth.seq • Camp action YAMLs: EstablishCamp, BreakCamp, GoToCamp, GoToBase, PromoteCampToBase, UpgradeBase, BreakBase (plus the Camping category) • Camp context prompt so followers know about the camp
Recommended if you want camping integrated into the SeverActions experience.
